requirements.description: Energy class D or better: includes all classes from A1 to D. Energy class D is the minimum acceptable rating.
User prefers properties near green spaces. 'Preferred' signals a proximity need, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26, rounded to 74).

The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area. The 45-child capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per child was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND green >= 74 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (property_type 'Attività scolastiche'), surface_area of at least 600 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1 through D, and green score of at least 74. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates. tipologia_bene_immobile is not in the filterable columns, so property_type is used for the typology filter.
